# Ruby Gillis

[Queen’s Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)</sub>
- **Role:** teacher (since v2)  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P60](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0060)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Susan](../character/susan.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Ruby Gillis possesses showy looks, highlighted by large, bright-blue eyes and a brilliant complexion. She has a plump, striking figure and wears her hair in a long yellow braid.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P43](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0043), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P1](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0001)_

## Personality

Ruby Gillis is a cheerful and good-tempered individual who enjoys the pleasant things in life, though she is inclined to be hysterical. Preoccupied with romance, she aims to have a gay time surrounded by dozens of admirers and suitors before eventually marrying. In her youth, her plans included teaching for just two years after finishing her studies and securing a beau as early as age fifteen.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P39](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0039), [v1 CHAPTER XXIII. ## History

Ruby Gillis previously attended school and Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) alongside [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), having famously charmed all her warts away with a magic pebble. She later participated in a dramatization of Elaine with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), and [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), which ended in a dangerous mishap when their boat leaked and began to sink. As examinations approached at Queen's, Ruby joined her ambitious classmates in anxiously preparing for tests and discussing commencement attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVI. Diana Is Invited to Tea with Tragic Results P18](../source/v01-c16.md#nw-v01-c16-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P11](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P18](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0018), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P23](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0023), [v1 CHAPTER XXVIII. An Unfortunate Lily Maid P31](../source/v01-c28.md#nw-v01-c28-p0031), [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), +4 more_
